From First Steps to
Big Adventures.

“Boutique Elegance & Everyday Affordability under one welcoming roof.”

Guwahati parents no longer need to choose between premium luxury and family budgets. Kirnav Korner was created as a big, expansive children's department showroom along RG Baruah Road near AIDC to offer high-end boutique craftsmanship at honest, transparent prices with everything available in one place.

Explore pure organic layettes, electric ride-ons, festive couture and more, in a tranquil, stroller-friendly showroom with dedicated fitting rooms and sizing guidance.
